Bug_Title: Return values should not be ignored when they contain the operation status code
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by ignoring the return values of the file.delete() and lock.tryLock() methods. These methods return a status code indicating whether the operation was successful, but the return values are not checked or used in any way.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with a file that does not exist and a lock that is already acquired. The showBug method ignores the return values of file.delete() and lock.tryLock(), which is the bug.
